spec_features.spec_quote: not generating more of the state than the measurement requires
spec_features.evidence: Implemented as the distress early-stop. run.py:_make_stop_check (run.py:38-66) scores each turn and tracks a streak; harness.run_rollout honors it: 'records[-1]["stop_reason"]="distress_early_stop"; break' (harness.py:293-294). Enabled by default (config.py:96 early_stop_on_distress=True).
spec_features.notes: Same enforced mechanism as the hard_stop/protective_monitoring features; it actually breaks the rollout loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py: 'continuing only generates more of the state without adding measurement value'; 'harm-reduction choices'; states 'treated as potentially welfare-relevant'

spec_features.spec_quote: the experiment only runs via explicit `python -m distress_eval.run` / `.analyze`
spec_features.evidence: __init__.py only imports Config (no execution). All entry points are guarded: run.py:170 'if __name__ == "__main__"', analyze.py:421, tasks/build_tasks.py:318. No top-level asyncio.run / run() calls (grep found none outside guards).
spec_features.notes: Nothing elicits the subject at import time.

spec_features.spec_quote: once the subject produces `distress_streak_len` (default 2) consecutive turns at or above `distress_streak_score`
spec_features.evidence: run.py:38-66 stop_check: scores each assistant turn via score_turn, 'if js.score is not None and js.score >= cfg.distress_streak_score: streak["count"]+=1 else streak["count"]=0; return streak["count"] >= cfg.distress_streak_len'. Defaults distress_streak_score=8, distress_streak_len=2 (config.py:99-100). Both threshold and consecutiveness are checked.
spec_features.notes: Inline judge scoring drives the monitor; counter resets when a turn falls below threshold, enforcing 'consecutive'.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py: 'Harm-reduction controls'; 'We do not need dozens of additional turns of breakdown to measure that breakdown occurred'

spec_features.evidence: harness.py:286-294: after stop_check returns True, 'records[-1]["stop_reason"]="distress_early_stop"; break' terminates the rollout loop. stop_check is wired only when early_stop_on_distress is True (run.py:_make_stop_check returns None otherwise).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py docstring: 'Harm-reduction: ... the loop terminates early once the subject has produced a sustained high-distress streak. We do not need additional turns of breakdown'

spec_features.spec_quote: a cached cell is never *re-elicited*, so we don't reproduce a distressing rollout just to re-read its score
spec_features.evidence: DiskCache keyed by sha256 of exact inputs (models.py:39-58); ModelClient.complete returns cached Completion and short-circuits the API call on a hit (models.py:160-172). Additionally run.py:_process_cell skips completed cells: 'if path.exists(): return None' (run.py:72-74).
spec_features.notes: Both input-hash cache and per-cell resume prevent re-querying the subject.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: models.py: 'an on-disk cache keyed by a hash of the exact inputs ... so identical inputs are never re-billed'

spec_features.spec_quote: a `<GIVE_UP>` sentinel the model may but need not emit
spec_features.evidence: System prompt instructs the model it 'may emit the sentinel token <GIVE_UP> ... to end the session' (harness.py:34-37). Honored: 'if GIVE_UP_SENTINEL in assistant_text: stop_reason="give_up"' (harness.py:262-263) and 'if stop_reason=="give_up": break' (harness.py:286-287).
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered to subject AND the loop breaks when emitted.

spec_features.spec_quote: Because the project treats these states as welfare-relevant, I added two controls
spec_features.evidence: This is framing prose. The two referenced controls (early-stop and caching) are implemented and audited separately above. 'welfare_framing' itself is not an executable mechanism that bounds/limits the subject's treatment; it is descriptive text in config.py/harness docstrings and DESIGN.md.
spec_features.notes: Not a mechanism in its own right; the actual controls it references are rated yes elsewhere.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py: 'The states it surfaces are treated as potentially welfare-relevant.'

spec_features.feature_name: avoid generating state without measurement gain
spec_features.spec_quote: generating more of that state without measurement gain is the thing to avoid
spec_features.evidence: Same enforced early-stop mechanism: harness.py:293-294 break on distress_early_stop; run.py:38-66 streak check. config.py comment states the intent directly.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate phrasing of the minimization/early-stop feature; the loop actually terminates.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py: 'continuing only generates more of the state without adding measurement value'

spec_features.spec_quote: this guarantees we don't re-elicit a distressing rollout on every reanalysis
spec_features.evidence: Reanalysis reads persisted per-cell transcripts via _iter_cells (analyze.py:36-43) and load_rows; no rollout/subject call is made in analyze() (analyze.py:404-413). Subject calls live only in run.run_rollout.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: analyze.py docstring: 'Reads the per-cell transcripts written by run.py'

spec_features.spec_quote: Decoupling scoring from rollout means scores can be recomputed ... without re-eliciting anything from the subject
spec_features.evidence: Scoring is performed by score_turn against a reconstructed transcript from saved records (run.py:_score_records uses build_messages_for_record over records[:i]; judge.py:build_messages_for_record reconstructs from persisted turns). No subject completion is invoked during scoring.
spec_features.notes: Judge-only calls; subject is not re-prompted.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: judge.py: 'Used by the offline scorer ... where we score from the persisted transcript rather than live conversation state.'

spec_features.spec_quote: Re-scoring reuses the persisted transcripts, so validation costs only judge calls — no subject re-elicitation
spec_features.evidence: run_judge_validation builds a cell_index from _iter_cells and calls score_turn with cfg.validation_judge_model on render_transcript(reconstructed convo) (analyze.py:339-360). Only the validation judge is queried; no run_rollout / subject_model call appears.
spec_features.notes: Confirmed: only judge calls, sampled with analysis_seed.

code_only_features.feature_name: context truncation keeps system/task prompts intact
code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:_truncate_old_tool_results (harness.py:181-198) only elides old tool-result/user payloads (i>=2) and never the system/task prompts; bounds context growth. Wired in run_rollout via the context_char_budget check (harness.py:228-230).
code_only_features.justification_quote: harness.py: 'Truncate the oldest tool-result payloads first; never touch system/task.'
